menu.title: Weather and time
menu.forecast_description: Inspect the running event, its internal stages and the current weather.
menu.time_description: Configure real time, clock speed and the night period.
menu.engine_description: Choose how forecasts are built, repeated and synchronized.
menu.fixed_description: Set the only weather used while Fixed mode is selected.
menu.static_description: Set the chance for each weather to appear alone in Dynamic mode.
menu.sequences_description: Create, order and configure the internal weather stages of each event.
menu.rebuild_description: Discard the current position and return to the first valid event.
menu.unique_description: Choose the only event that repeats continuously in Unique weather mode.
menu.status_open: View the profile, clock, mode, event and weather actually running.

mode_description.dynamic: Selects the next event using its configured probability, while strictly preserving the order and duration of weather stages inside the chosen event.
mode_description.sequential: Runs events in administrative order. Inside each event, every weather stage follows its configured duration.
mode_description.fixed: Keeps only the weather selected under Fixed weather. The queue does not advance to other events.
mode_description.daily_fixed: One event occupies a full game-clock day. Its weather steps are evenly distributed across 24 hours; the next event starts at midnight.
mode_description.unique: Repeats only the city's selected default event. Its internal position resumes after a restart.

time.title: Clock and time
time.real_time_description: Synchronizes the game clock with the server machine clock. While enabled, startup time and simulated scales do not control the clock.
time.night_scale_description: Allows game minutes to run at another speed during the night period.
time.day_scale_description: Each game minute lasts %{value} ms outside the night period.
time.night_scale_value_description: Each game minute lasts %{value} ms during the night.
time.night_window_description: Starts at %{beginning}:00 and ends at %{ending}:00. The range may cross midnight.
time.startup_description: Without real time, the clock starts at %{hour}:%{minute}.
time.force_description: Current persistent time: %{hour}:%{minute}. The change is applied and saved immediately.
time.freeze_description: Keeps the current time stopped and saves this choice so it continues after a restart.
time.scalable_description: Uses separate durations, in seconds, for daytime and nighttime game minutes.
time.scalable_status_description: The scale controls only the game clock; it does not change sequential weather duration.
time.scalable_ignored_description: Real time is enabled. Scale, startup time, freezing and manual time remain saved but do not control the clock.
time.scalable_menu_description: Configure how many seconds each game minute lasts during day and night.
time.force_real_disabled: Unavailable while real time is enabled.
time.freeze_with_force: Freeze the clock at this time
time.freeze_real_description: Real time has priority and cannot be frozen.
time.default_speed_description: With real and scalable time disabled, each game minute lasts %{value} second(s).

engine.title: Weather engine
engine.repeat_cycle_description: Generates another queue when one ends. Disabled: keeps the last event indefinitely.
engine.daily_seed_description: Uses the date as a seed. Restarts on the same day produce the same selection; the next day changes it.
engine.scheduled_description: Allows special txAdmin transitions before a scheduled restart.
engine.december_snow_description: In December, replaces the forecast with snowy Christmas weather.
engine.duration_description: Generates approximately %{value} hours of events per queue.
engine.cycle_timer_description: An independent weather event added by Dynamic mode lasts %{value} minutes.
engine.december_snow_ground_description: In December, forces only snow on the ground; events and weather types continue normally.

fixed.title: Fixed weather
fixed.weather_description: Weather held while Fixed mode is active.
fixed.snow_description: Enables snow behavior even for a custom weather setup.

static.title: Independent weather
static.enabled_description: Allows Dynamic mode to test the chances below after sequences.
static.chance_description: Current chance: %{chance}. Every test is independent; zero prevents this weather from this list.

sequence.title: Configure event
sequence.system_enabled_description: Allows the engine to run registered weather events.
sequence.create_description: Creates an event with one sunny weather stage ready to configure.
sequence.list_description: Current order | %{count} weather stage(s) | Probability %{chance} | Month: %{month}
sequence.builder_help: An event contains an ordered internal weather sequence. Example: Smog → Clear → Extra sunny. The engine never shuffles these stages.
sequence.enabled_description: When disabled, the event stays saved but does not enter cycles.
sequence.split_regions_description: Propagates weather as a front across the map (Area 1 on weather N, Area 2 on weather N+1).
sequence.probability_description: In Dynamic mode this event has a %{chance} chance to be selected. Probability never changes its internal order.
sequence.wind_direction_description: Base direction %{direction}°. Each event may override it.
sequence.add_event_description: Adds a new weather stage to the end of this event.
sequence.delete_description: Permanently removes the event and all of its weather stages.
sequence.force_description: Interrupts the current event, starts this event at the position required by the active mode, and saves the new state.
sequence.rename_description: The number is calculated automatically from order; change only the name.
sequence.name: Event name

event.title: Configure event weather
event.weather_description: Weather type for this internal stage. Stages remain in the displayed order.
event.duration_description: Sequential, Dynamic and Unique modes use between %{minimum} and %{maximum} minutes. Fixed daily mode uses the 24-hour split.
event.wind_description: Speed %{speed}; direction %{direction}°. These values apply only to this stage.
event.snow_description: Tells clients to apply snow behavior for this stage.
event.duplicate_description: Creates a copy immediately after this stage.
event.delete_description: Removes this weather stage from the event.

forecast.title: Running forecast
forecast.explanation_description: Shows the stages of the running event and highlights the current weather. State is saved so it continues after a restart.
forecast.change_weather_description: Changes only this event in the running queue.
forecast.duration_description: This event remains for %{minutes} more minutes.
forecast.remove_description: Removes only this event from the running forecast.
forecast.remove_confirm: Remove this event from the running queue?
forecast.force_weather_description: Immediately moves to this position of the event and lets you choose the weather.
forecast.dynamic_pending: It will be selected by probability on the current event's last step and then persisted.

weather_description.clear: Clear sky and a smooth neutral transition.
weather_description.clearing: Weather clearing after clouds or rain.
weather_description.thunder: Heavy rain with lightning and thunder.

unique.event_description: %{count} weather stage(s) in the internal cycle.
unique.explanation_description: In Fixed weather mode, only the selected event repeats and its internal position resumes after restarts.
unique.title: City fixed event

profiles.title: Weather and time profiles
profiles.description: Active profile: %{profile}. Save yearly, Christmas, Easter or Halloween setups.
profiles.active_description: %{profile} controls the city's time and weather JSON files.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.create_current_description: Copies the entire active time and weather configuration.
profiles.create_clean_description: Creates a simple sunny event as a fresh starting point.
profiles.import_description: Paste an exported bundle. Everything is validated before saving.
profiles.activate_continue_description: Saves the current profile, activates this one and resumes its persisted position.
profiles.activate_restart_description: Activates this profile and starts at its first valid event.
profiles.activate_restart_confirm: This profile's persisted position will be reset. Continue?
profiles.rename_description: Updates the name and folder-safe identifier.
profiles.export_description: Copies a validated bundle with time.json and weather.json.
profiles.overwrite_description: Replaces this profile with the currently active settings.
profiles.overwrite_confirm: Replace this profile completely with the current one?
profiles.delete_description: Removes its folder, settings and persisted state.
profiles.delete_active_description: The active profile cannot be deleted. Activate another first.
